# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 38,370 across 2 platforms (youtube: 32,817, instagram: 5,553).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-08-23.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.3%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.0%.
- youtube: positive 63.4%, neutral 21.0%, negative 15.6%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.492, neutral 0.493, positive 0.506 (spread 0.014).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T4: think, new, agent, does - 12,373 posts.
- T10: real, cloud, engineer, world - 7,881 posts.
- T0: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand - 3,942 posts.
- T8: easy, understand, easy understand, simple - 1,367 posts.
- T9: time, save, save time, real time - 1,360 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand (+2.11 pts).
- Rising: T10: real, cloud, engineer, world (+1.32 pts).
- Rising: T5: start, ready, company, scratch (+0.49 pts).
- Declining: T7: rich, smart, broke, dumb (-0.6 pts).
- Declining: T4: think, new, agent, does (-2.58 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 6,698 posts.
- AI Agents - 5,264 posts.
- Automation - 4,274 posts.
- Startup - 3,968 posts.
- Digital Marketing - 3,094 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=12, UMass coherence -0.8329 (more coherent than LDA).
